text:
marie: Quick procurement check-in — NexaSupply just updated lead times for the H100 backfill. AMS customs backlog is holding the batch. Vendor suggests we split: air-expedite 10 units (arrive in 4 business days) + sea for remaining 40 (ETA ~3 weeks). Air delta is ~$8k and requires consolidated AWB for returns. Any blockers on routing or staging?

alex (ops): Can we absorb 10 air units into crossdock and stage them? what's ETA on paperwork?

nora (NexaSupply): Hi all — confirmed. Air ETA 4 business days from pickup (we can prioritize). Sea is 18–22 days. We can do partial RMA on the lot (send replacement subset now, remainder as sea). We can also generate consolidated paperwork to speed customs clearance. AWB examples below:

```
AWB: 123-45678901 (air, expedited)
Return-AWB placeholder: R-987654321
```

nora (NexaSupply): Also note HS code discrepancy flagged by AMS customs; recommend using HS 8471.70 to avoid hold. We can add commercial invoice note re: "replacement under warranty" to reduce duties.

luis (eng-sre): Quick Q — any firmware mismatch risk on split shipment? we had a small pool with mismatched firmware before and it caused provisioning flakiness. DOA rate on last batch?

nora (NexaSupply): DOA historically ~0.8% for H100 in recent shipments. For firmware: we can pre-stage a firmware parity check at vendor before ship if you want — adds 6–8 hours but reduces mismatch risk. We can also ship with serial-tagged manifest so you can auto-apply firmware at staging.

marie (procurement): We should ask for firmware parity for the 10 air units. We'll cover the +$8k if ops needs them early. Is expedited fee waivable if we accept consolidated invoice and full return flow?

nora (NexaSupply): I can escalate — possible partial waiver if we cover freight and sign consolidated return manifest. I'll confirm by EOD.

ashley (warehouse): Crossdock capacity is tight this week. We can take 10 air units but will need them processed same-day into staging racking. Need an exact pickup window. Also confirm whether returns need preprinted RT labels.

alex (ops): If warehouse can stage same-day we'll take the 10. ops-can run a quick health smoke on arrival and then route to eng for burn-in. Ask NexaSupply to include manifest CSV with serials so our onboarding script picks them up.

nora (NexaSupply): Understood — we'll include CSV with columns: `serial,model,fw_version,ship_date,awt_location`. Example attached in channel (CSV snippet). We'll also do firmware parity run for the air subset.

shipbot: label-created: AWB 123-45678901 (expedite), label R-987654321 (return) :package:

marie (procurement): One more constraint — EU procurement team flagged budget approval needs before we commit +$8k. Can operations absorb interim cost on the corporate card and we invoice them after?

alex (ops): We can cover interim up to $6k. Need finance sign-off for remaining. If NexaSupply can reduce fee, that helps.

nora (NexaSupply): I'll push for a $3k reduction tied to consolidated paperwork. If approved, new air delta becomes ~$5k. Will update by EOD.

luis (eng-sre): Also request that any replacement units include a tag `FOR-FAST-BURNIN` in the manifest so our scripts prioritize them.

ashley (warehouse): Noted. Please ensure shipping labels have `STAGING-RACK-3` in address line 2. That speeds inbound.

marie (procurement): Action items: 1) Nora to confirm fee reduction & waiver status by EOD. 2) Nora to attach serial CSV + firmware parity note. 3) Ashley to confirm crossdock availability window for 4 business days out. 4) Alex/luis to prep burn-in script to accept manifest tag.

nora (NexaSupply): Will do all 3. If customs accepts HS override and paperwork we may shave 24–48h off transit.

marie (procurement): Thanks — please reply in-thread with the confirmed numbers so finance can fast-track approval. :thumbsup:

alex (ops): ack.

ashley (warehouse): ack, staging slot tentative booked pending exact pickup window.

shipbot: reminder-sent: return-labels must be printed within 48h of delivery for consolidated RMA flow.

nora (NexaSupply): Update @marie — negotiated: waive $2k of expedite fee if you sign consolidated return manifest; final delta now $6k. Manifest and CSV uploaded to our portal (link). ETA remains 4 business days for air.

marie (procurement): Great — FYI finance approved interim cover. Proceed with air + firmware parity. Please post final AWB after pickup.

alex (ops): once AWB posted we'll drop into `ops-ingest` and run the smoke pipeline.

luis (eng-sre): I'll patch the onboarding script to watch for `FOR-FAST-BURNIN`. Happy to help on manifest parsing.

ashley (warehouse): prepping inbound paperwork. print area reserved.

shipbot: shipment-scanned: AWB 123-45678901 scanned at pickup 2026-03-18 09:12 UTC.

marie (procurement): Closing loop — thanks everyone. Keep thread updated if customs hiccup appears.
